'''Felicia''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] refugee who was captured by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the [[Battle of Dibrook]]. She and the other refugees were taken to a [[Shaper research facility]], where they were transformed into [[thrall]]s. Felicia would later attack a man who recognized her during a [[Rescue Mission to Dibrook|rescue mission]] to save the refugees.<ref name="Invasion Rescues 5" />
